forbidden_scope: Real Chengfeng access, login, browser automation, credentials, production images, platform writes, or cloud OCR
Legacy project scripts, databases, runtimes, processes, ports, browser profiles, caches, or application-data mutation
Using platform weight, upload slot, file name, or expected role to select or rank OCR candidates

assumptions: The code-owned synthetic tests validate the release mechanism and safety contracts, not real ticket accuracy.
Human review truth and scene attestations will be supplied independently and honestly; software can verify structure, identity, consistency, and provenance but cannot prove reviewer honesty.
The current perceptual similarity detector is a conservative candidate generator and all near-duplicate decisions remain human-confirmed.
The formal locked set remains unavailable, so this run can only verify tooling and leave the release gate pending.
